shots.note: camera pans down-left from the big building to an ordinary small house (small-house from the starter library) on a rainy grey street; on شخص عادي a white NPill «شخص عادي»; on بيته its window lights warm; on يرتب a faceless silhouette moves boxes behind the window

NightMap paper of Great Britain; Wales fills gold (spread from Newport); YearBadge 2013 counts back from 2025 top-right on سنة; on نيوبورت a pin drops + white NPill «نيوبورت»; on ويلز NPill «ويلز» on the region

RoomWorld (grey rainy window): StoryPerson man (hoodie, gold rim) + white name pill «جيمس هاولز» on جيمس; around him cardboard boxes and old cables; on ينظف he picks up an old box; on ويرمي old things (a cable, a lamp, a box) arc into an open black bin bag by the door

shell game begins: on a dark table under one lamp, two IDENTICAL hard drives (hard-drive-blank art) pop side by side on هارديسكين; on نفس الشيء they glide and swap places twice like cups in a shell game (move() eased); gold NPill «نفس الشيء بالضبط» on بالضبط

shots.idea: shell game: two identical hard drives shuffle, and the one with the glowing bitcoin key drops into the black bin bag
shots.note: ★ the drop: the two drives (key still faintly glowing in the right one) shuffle once more on the table; StoryPerson Howells' hand-rim reaches in; on رميت he picks the GLOWING one and drops it into the black bin bag below (it falls, the bag swallows the glow, thump); the empty drive stays on the table under the lamp; Bubble «رميت الغلط» ✖ from Howells at the edge

a gold ₿ coin (coinArt) shoots up like a rocket on طار, trailing a green rising line (WalletBalance-style ▲ trend) across a night sky; on واليوم the line levels high and sparkles

back to the MistakeBill (match: the coin flies into it): row «اليوم» prints and counts to «590–630 مليون $» (590 on 147.5, –630 on 148.24, gold total on مليون); the «وقتها» row above greys out — then vs today in one look; no stamp

the landfill behind a tall fence (LandfillSlice exterior/landfill plate edge): on ملك البلدية a gold NPill «ملك البلدية» hangs on the gate; on تصاريح البيئة a green permit card with a leaf pops; on تمنع الحفر a red sign «ممنوع الحفر» slams onto the fence (Stamp red) and a pickaxe icon gets ✖

shots.fallback: LandfillSlice exterior: the whole mountain pulled back on a grey CloudWorld with city lights beyond

host.why: buried under a whole city's rubbish
